title: Felix and the Atlas
author: Ada Underhill
blurb: Gideon Thackeray, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
